note: Page-level pixel diff on DemucsPage at 1440x900. after = natural tokenized render; sentinel = tokens overridden to #ff00ff/#00ffff/#00ff00; before_literal = tokens set to the exact old literal hex (#a83232/#2e6b47/#9d6638). Threshold: a channel diff > 2 counts as changed.

after_vs_sentinel.purpose: proves the three tokens are load-bearing for demucs UI colour

after_vs_before_literal.purpose: tokenised render vs old-literal render must be identical => rendered colour unchanged
after_vs_before_literal.note: 0 pixels differ beyond threshold. getbbox() shows a thin 13px strip (282-295 x) with channel deltas of 1-2 (sub-threshold edge anti-aliasing), not a colour change.
after_vs_before_literal.method: captured back-to-back with NO user interaction to exclude the live 'measured elapsed' timer as a temporal differential (an earlier post-click capture showed 2357 px of timer/chrome drift from that timer, not from colour).
